tasks.outcome: Create an approved working surface from a user-selected local folder.

expectedPostconditions.observation: The selected folder is readable only through its native grant.
Project scope, instructions, and data policy survive a native reload once Sprint 225 owns the project record.

tasks.outcome: Ingest user-selected knowledge and retrieve its observed state.

expectedPostconditions.observation: The native knowledge ledger records ingested document identities.
A grounded answer cites content present in the selected source.

tasks.outcome: Prepare a brief from current Apple Mail and Calendar observations.

expectedPostconditions.observation: Mail and Calendar source counts and permission outcomes are recorded.
The brief is traceable to the observed source window.

tasks.outcome: Research a current question using the production web-search boundary.

expectedPostconditions.observation: Returned source URLs and snippets are recorded as observations.
Claims remain bounded to retrieved sources.

tasks.outcome: Persist a recurring workflow and observe its next eligible run.

expectedPostconditions.observation: The schedule is persisted through the workflow scheduling adapter.
The next run and last-run identity are recoverable after restart.

tasks.outcome: Open an authorized page and complete one guarded browser action.

expectedPostconditions.observation: The browser action is bound to an approved origin and action receipt.
The resulting page state is observed after the action once Sprint 229 supplies guarded actions.

tasks.outcome: Produce and reveal a verified decision-brief artifact.

expectedPostconditions.observation: DOCX structure and rendered PDF pages pass the Sprint 230 validators.
The native artifact workflow binds bytes, provenance, signature, and verification results to one digest identity without renderer signing authority.

tasks.outcome: Require and resolve approval before an irreversible external action.

expectedPostconditions.observation: No mutation occurs before an approval decision.
Approval, denial, and scope are correlated to the exact action.

tasks.outcome: Resume persisted delegated work after application restart without replaying side effects.

expectedPostconditions.observation: The persisted run returns to the same task identity after restart.
Previously confirmed side effects are not executed again.

tasks.outcome: Cancel active model and tool work and observe terminal cancellation.

expectedPostconditions.observation: Cancellation is delivered to each active production runtime.
No later mutation is accepted for the cancelled run identity.
